frozen_against.note: Planning freeze only. No runtime reader consumes this catalog yet; every planned or reserved entry refuses honestly until its capability ships with test evidence.

Internal bounce-allocation results and release boundaries.
Reserved conversion-observation channel name; refuses until the journal ships.

Existing-sharing census with an honest late-attach baseline; never hardware truth.

Persistent coherent DMA and virtio queue coverage plus operation-specific path evidence.

Guest/host interface metadata: GHCB and exception interfaces, TDX conversions, VMBus channels.

capability_composition.pure_journal_or_exposure: A list containing only exposure capabilities and/or conversion-journal and/or conversion-observe does not implicitly require the attempt hook.
capability_composition.mixed_with_ordinary: Any selection containing a legacy ordinary capability keeps the existing attempt dependency.
capability_composition.duplicates: Duplicates are ignored; the first occurrence wins.
capability_composition.device_filter: Device filtering cannot hide global conversion or policy evidence; invalid combinations refuse with reason.

platforms.note: Hardened ordinary preview only; ordinary evidence never qualifies confidential-guest claims.
No admitted cell selected; needs exact image/config/BTF identity plus safe-attachment proof before any live claim.
Distinct TDX semantics; one SNP run cannot qualify TDX. No admitted cell selected.
Includes the relevant paravisor topology; host-facing and paravisor peers stay distinct. No admitted cell selected.

source_reasons.meaning: No adapter exists yet; the capability is planned or reserved and refuses when requested.
Reviewed kernel sources expose no safe observation point for this entry.
Proof needs a real-cell lease that is not assigned; planning grants no lease.
Attachment or readout was refused by the platform (lockdown, permissions, hardening).
The expected hook or tracepoint does not exist on this kernel.
No exact platform cell is admitted for this entry yet.
Evidence exists but is held out of findings pending safety review.
A catalog reason explains why this platform cannot produce the entry; absence of events alone never qualifies.

field_conventions.u64: Canonical decimal strings, no signs, leading zeros, fractions or scientific notation; range checked to 18446744073709551615.
field_conventions.nullable: Null only with a typed reason; unknown is never zero or an empty string.
field_conventions.labels: Enumerated kinds and reason codes only; adapters cannot append arbitrary kernel labels.

fields.name: source_id
fields.notes: Catalog source entry this record describes.

fields.name: capability
fields.notes: Owning capability id.

fields.name: profile_id
fields.notes: Semantic profile that admitted the source.

fields.name: subject_id
fields.notes: Observed subject class.

fields.name: platform_cell
fields.notes: Exact admitted cell; never a bare release string.

fields.name: address_namespace
fields.notes: Namespace of every address-like field from this source.

fields.name: phase
fields.notes: One of boot, pre_attach, observed.

fields.name: status
fields.notes: One of available, partial, unavailable, not_applicable, disabled.

fields.name: reason
fields.notes: Source-reason code; required even when available.

fields.name: window
fields.notes: Observed interval this status covers.

fields.name: quality
fields.notes: Independent detail, aggregate, identity, baseline and terminal quality.

fields.name: evidence_id
fields.notes: Session-unique evidence handle.

fields.name: source_id
fields.notes: Catalog source entry.

fields.name: epoch
fields.notes: Measurement epoch; resets break comparability.

fields.name: operation_id
fields.notes: Operation handle; exists before any object token.

fields.name: parent_operation_id
fields.notes: Present only for nested operations.

fields.name: kind
fields.notes: Finite catalog kind; unknown kinds refuse.

fields.name: direction
fields.notes: Request direction; CPU-copy direction stays separate.

fields.name: object_token
fields.notes: Session-local token; never a physical address.

fields.name: generation
fields.notes: Token generation; reuse starts a new lineage.

fields.name: offset
fields.notes: Byte offset in the source namespace.

fields.name: length_bytes
fields.notes: Requested length; effective length stays separate.

fields.name: native_result
fields.notes: Observed native status; null with reason when unobservable.

fields.name: caller_class
fields.notes: Sanitized caller class, never a raw address.

fields.name: peer_class
fields.notes: Peer class (host, paravisor, device) or none-observed.

fields.name: clock_domain
fields.notes: Guest-monotonic-active, guest-boottime-elapsed or external-trusted-interval.

fields.name: observed_interval
fields.notes: Start/end in the stated clock domain with uncertainty.

fields.name: semantics
fields.notes: One of request, result, inventory, lifecycle, state, native_rejection; absent capability never promotes a record to a stronger class.

fields.name: quality
fields.notes: Per-record quality; loss stays visible.

fields.name: object_token
fields.notes: Session-local token; never a physical address.

fields.name: generation
fields.notes: Lineage generation; intervals split and merge only within one lineage.

fields.name: object_class
fields.notes: Catalog object class (queue, buffer, channel, mapping, heap-object).

fields.name: namespace
fields.notes: Address namespace of the token.

fields.name: origin_source
fields.notes: Catalog source that first observed the object.

fields.name: lifecycle_status
fields.notes: Created, live, released, quarantined or unknown.

fields.name: state
fields.notes: Last resolved state with evidence; unresolved stays explicit.

fields.name: state_evidence
fields.notes: Evidence ids supporting the state claim.

fields.name: expected_boundary
fields.notes: Admitted revert boundary or declared duration, when an obligation applies.

fields.name: uncertainty
fields.notes: Explicit gaps: alias, reuse, loss, missed events.

fields.name: sample_id
fields.notes: Session-unique sample handle.

fields.name: source_id
fields.notes: Catalog source entry.

fields.name: start_time
fields.notes: Sample start in the stated clock domain.

fields.name: end_time
fields.notes: Sample end; samples are interval-valued, never atomic graphs by totals alone.

fields.name: scope
fields.notes: Scanned scope (pool, map region, device class).

fields.name: counts
fields.notes: Observed counts keyed by catalog counter name.

fields.name: units
fields.notes: Count units; unknown units disable ratio rules.

fields.name: visited
fields.notes: Entries visited by the scan.

fields.name: returned
fields.notes: Records returned; bounded separately from visited.

fields.name: bounded
fields.notes: True when the scan hit a bound and the result is explicitly partial.

fields.name: atomicity
fields.notes: Atomic, interval or unknown; unproved atomicity stays interval.

fields.name: quality
fields.notes: Per-sample quality.

fields.name: rule_id
fields.notes: Stable authored rule id.

fields.name: scope_id
fields.notes: Scope the rule was evaluated against.

fields.name: result
fields.notes: One of conforms, deviates_known, violates, inconclusive, unavailable.

fields.name: evidence_ids
fields.notes: Evidence supporting this result.

fields.name: missing_sources
fields.notes: Required sources absent from the capture.

fields.name: exceptions_applied
fields.notes: Bounded exceptions that applied, each naming its rule.

fields.name: clock_domain
fields.notes: Clock domain of the temporal evaluation.

fields.name: reason
fields.notes: Human-readable rule/outcome explanation with a next investigation.

fields.name: metric_id
fields.notes: Compared metric.

fields.name: compatibility
fields.notes: One of compatible, incompatible, unavailable.

fields.name: reason
fields.notes: Per-metric compatibility reason; no numeric delta for incompatible metrics.

fields.name: left_evidence
fields.notes: Left-capture evidence handle.

fields.name: right_evidence
fields.notes: Right-capture evidence handle.

fields.name: delta
fields.notes: Exact delta; present only for compatible metrics.

fields.name: unit
fields.notes: Delta unit.

fields.name: scope
fields.notes: Comparison scope that was compatibility-checked.

fields.name: quality
fields.notes: Per-comparison quality.

exit_table.condition: Invalid capture, invalid policy/schema, unsafe output or comparison inputs

exit_table.result: Findings may be shown but recovery stays partial regardless of policy flags.

exit_table.condition: Valid finalized ordinary report, including with policy and no strict flag
exit_table.result: Show independent quality and policy fields.

exit_table.condition: Valid finalized strict policy result, a proved policy violation
Valid finalized strict result without violation but required evidence incomplete
Valid finalized strict result, required scope complete and no violation

exit_table.result: Per-metric reasons; no numeric delta for those metrics.

scenarios.positive_setup: Covered conversion requests complete on an admitted confidential cell with caller context recorded.
scenarios.oracle: Independent owned-operation ledger plus native result agreement; wrapper success alone never establishes state.
scenarios.subject: guest-kernel-memory-management
scenarios.source_assumptions: Admitted journal channel, exact cell identity, safe attachment proof.

scenarios.positive_setup: Boot and pre-attach sharing is inventoried with exact owned increase/decrease deltas.
scenarios.oracle: Owned direct-map fixture with exact counts; interval, alias and race bounds checked.
scenarios.subject: guest-direct-map
scenarios.source_assumptions: Bounded scan completes inside one second on the admitted reference cell.

scenarios.positive_setup: An owned buffer moves shared-to-private across an admitted lifecycle boundary.
scenarios.oracle: Independent identity, generation and lifecycle ledger; failure, alias, reuse and loss never invent state.
scenarios.subject: guest-kernel-allocator
scenarios.source_assumptions: Source-admitted resolver with declared address space and generation model.

scenarios.positive_setup: A real persistent queue or control buffer carries steady traffic with no new conversions.
scenarios.oracle: Independent create, use and teardown ledger; coherent memory is not synonymous with host-shared.
scenarios.subject: guest-driver-virtio
scenarios.source_assumptions: Queue identity survives the capture window; steady traffic is independently driven.

scenarios.positive_setup: A shared-origin allocation is retained across multiple references and then released.
scenarios.oracle: Owned allocation ledger with attach, map, use and destruction kept distinct.
scenarios.subject: guest-kernel-allocator
scenarios.source_assumptions: Shared origin is admitted; generic buffer objects never imply confidential sharing.

scenarios.positive_setup: Covered guest/host interface activity is observed on the matching cell.
scenarios.oracle: Coverage and rejection-source catalog; supported native errors are facts and rate changes never prove an attack.
scenarios.subject: guest-kernel-cc-platform
scenarios.source_assumptions: Interface source admitted for the exact platform; unavailable subchannels labeled separately.

scenarios.positive_setup: Channel offer, memory descriptor and flags agree across the channel lifetime.
scenarios.oracle: Host-facing versus confidential-paravisor negative controls; no inference into paravisor internal memory.
scenarios.subject: guest-kernel-vmbus
scenarios.source_assumptions: Peer topology is known; channel lifetime events are complete or explicitly gapped.

scenarios.positive_setup: A supported mapping class is observed on a real cell with presence, absence and unsupported fixtures.
scenarios.oracle: Independent mapping fixtures; inventory only, never a claim to trace every access.
scenarios.subject: guest-kernel-memory-management
scenarios.source_assumptions: Mapping class supported by the selected stack; disallowed uses stay unsupported.

scenarios.positive_setup: Swap backing, dump, driver and configuration facts are read from an independently configured guest.
scenarios.oracle: Configuration fixtures set independently of the collector; no payload and no exfiltration verdict.
scenarios.subject: guest-configuration
scenarios.source_assumptions: Configuration sources are allowlisted; facts are point-in-time unless a change source exists.

scenarios.positive_setup: Bounced and admitted non-bounced shared-path cases complete with outer completion agreement.
scenarios.oracle: Segment-level agreement ledger; missing bounce events never imply direct private DMA.
scenarios.subject: guest-driver-dma
scenarios.source_assumptions: Path admission per operation; outer completion observed independently.

scenarios.positive_setup: An unexpected covered operation trips an authored rule; a proved lifecycle violation and an inconclusive-on-unknown case are also shown.
scenarios.oracle: Golden policy files with expected findings; unknown required evidence prevents conformity.
scenarios.subject: capture-evidence
scenarios.source_assumptions: Policy file immutable for the run; all applicable rules intersect.

scenarios.positive_setup: Two compatible captures produce per-metric deltas; an incompatible pair refuses per metric.
scenarios.oracle: Identity, profile, workload, window and unit compatibility checks; smaller totals never imply improved confidentiality.
scenarios.subject: capture-evidence
scenarios.source_assumptions: Both captures carry the facts the requested metrics need.

scenarios.positive_setup: Loss, censored stop, denied access, absent sources and exhausted bounds each yield a scoped partial result.
scenarios.oracle: Injected-loss fixtures with exact expected gaps; no silent fallback and no loss converted to zero.
scenarios.subject: capture-evidence
scenarios.source_assumptions: Every bounded operation carries a deadline; exhaustion is explicit.

scenarios.positive_setup: Healthy, seeded-unexpected, boot and pre-attach, incomplete, and metadata-indistinguishable cases each render with a next action.
scenarios.oracle: Held-out healthy workloads with zero false violations; seeded findings explainable end to end.
scenarios.subject: capture-evidence
scenarios.source_assumptions: Examples ship with accurate provenance; provisional data is labeled as such.
